description: Search LiveDataLink's self-hosted official USDA NASS Crop Production Annual Summary series. Returns canonical crop/class/metric combinations, units, exact 2019–2025 coverage, pagination, evidence hash, and attribution. Use this for 'what NASS crop series are hosted?', 'find durum wheat yield', or to resolve a series before history/trend calls. Scope is final national annual summaries, not the full Quick Stats catalog.

query.description: Optional crop, class, metric, unit, or description words.

response_format.description: Human-readable markdown or machine-readable JSON. Default markdown.

name: usda_nass_search_crop_series
